traditional: No classical doctrine: Pluto is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Mind meets power. Forceful, penetrating communication; words that can heal or wound and tend to be remembered. Psychologically the opposition is inner tension to integrate: Communication turns coercive or obsessive. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.meaning: Thinking and power reach full awareness and face each other: culmination, objectivity, fulfillment or confrontation.

business: Friction in this area. Sales, persuasion, research, and anything requiring depth and force of message.
shadow: Scattered overthinking collides with control and obsession; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: A confrontation builds; the other side comes fully into view.
arcSeparating: The standoff resolves into balance or a split.
base: A conversation can become a power struggle when one side keeps asking for answers and the other controls the information.

readerCopy.body: A conversation can become a power struggle when one side keeps asking for answers and the other controls the information. When Mercury opposes Pluto, communication meets leverage through withheld details, strategic silence, probing questions, or loaded language. More pressure can make the imbalance easier to see without producing the missing answer. Precise questions are especially useful because an attempt to evade them becomes information too.
